---
title: "kuststatistiek"
---

Python port of the KNMI wind and sea water level statistics (de Valk & van den Brink, R scripts delivered
in February 2026), made by HKV for the BOI coastal statistics. Every R script has a notebook that runs the
same steps in the same order. Starting from `set.seed(...)`, a notebook run gives the same results as the
R script, bootstrap samples included.

| R script (Feb2026)                                | Notebook |
|---------------------------------------------------|----------|
| `statistics-wind10-impr.Rmd`                      | [1. Statistiek wind](examples/notebooks/1_statistics_wind.ipynb) |
| `production-wind10-impr.Rmd`                      | [2. Productie wind](examples/notebooks/2_production_wind.ipynb) |
| `statistics-wl10-impr.Rmd`                        | [3. Statistiek waterstand](examples/notebooks/3_statistics_wl.ipynb) |
| `statistics-wl10others-impr.Rmd`                  | [4. Overige locaties](examples/notebooks/4_statistics_wl_others.ipynb) |
| `statistics-wl10-omni-texeln-impr.Rmd`            | [5. Texel Noordzee](examples/notebooks/5_statistics_wl_texeln.ipynb) |
| `production-wl10extended-impr.Rmd`                | [6. Productie waterstand](examples/notebooks/6_production_wl.ipynb) |
| `dependence-wlwind10-impr.Rmd` (production chunk) | [7. Afhankelijkheid](examples/notebooks/7_dependence.ipynb) |

The notebooks are shown here without output: they need the KNMI input data and take hours to run. See the
README of the repository for how to run them. The notebook texts are in Dutch.

The package is published under the GNU GPL-3 license.
